snippet.title: Scratchin' Melodii - Dragon Funk (Gameplay Preview)
snippet.description:
Here's a preview of Dragon Funk, a rival battle against Pitaya in my game, Scratchin' Melodii! Feat. BethyVA as Pitaya! 🐉

Wishlist Scratchin' Melodii on Steam here!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2728050/Scratchin_Melodii/

Credits:
Music, Art, Animation, Etc - LJ LephemStar
Vocal Tuning/Mixing - Mia (2cada)
Voice of Pitaya - BethyVA
